name: Crate Remote
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Browse both USBs on an iPad or phone, see what fits the playing deck, queue picks.
description: Uses the network: serves one web page on port 8765 to devices on the deck's Wi-Fi, gated by a PIN shown on this mod's Mod Menu page. The page lists both USBs' tracks and playlists (read-only), shows the four decks, ranks tracks that fit the deck you're mixing from by Camelot key and BPM (including half/double time), and lets you queue picks; each pick shows as a banner on the deck. It never loads tracks, writes the library, or touches controls: you still load with LOAD. Turn it off with the iPad browser row, which closes the port.
